title: Envoy from the Inner Sect
next_chapter_hook: Just as the crowd began to disperse, Chen Ji lowered his head to wipe the Turtle Shell. His fingertips inadvertently touched that line of runes—his pupils contracted sharply. It was a symbol never seen before on his father's legacy, yet there it was, clearly carved onto the Turtle Shell.

text.content: Before the third morning bell finished echoing through the mountains, the Servants' Quarters was already crowded with a dark mass of people. Chen Ji mingled at the end of the crowd, the Turtle Shell in his hand gradually cooling from its scalding heat, yet that warmth still lingered in his palm, like a fine needle, pricking neither too light nor too hard. 'The moon hides behind the misty mountain, illuminating the people of old'—Su Qingyao's words still reverberated in his ears, resonating with the runes that had suddenly appeared on the Turtle Shell, as if something long dormant was awakening.

A jade-green sedan chair glided down the Mountain Path, carried by four Inner Sect disciples whose footsteps were soundless, as steady as treading on cotton. The curtain lifted, revealing a middle-aged man in a dark cyan brocade robe—thin-faced with three long whiskers falling to his chest, a jade pendant engraved with the character 'Observe' hanging from his waist, the unmistakable insignia of an Inner Sect steward.

dialogue.content: Tianqing Sect Outer Disciple Chen Ji, where are you?

text.content: His voice, though not loud, cut through the crowd, reaching everyone's ears. The surrounding disciples parted like water, their gazes fixed on Chen Ji with a complex mix of shock, envy, and disbelief. How could this waste who had swept the grounds for three years attract the attention of an Inner Sect Elder?

Chen Ji stepped out from the crowd, his pace neither fast nor slow, his expression respectful without subservience. He slightly bowed in greeting, his posture flawless—not a single error, yet not a single extra movement either. The steward's gaze lingered on him for a moment, sweeping casually over his left hand hidden in his sleeve, a meaningful smile tugging at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: By order of the Inner Sect Elder—the servant disciple Chen Ji, whose performance in last month's Sect Competition was outstanding, has been reviewed and approved by the Elder Council. He is hereby officially entered into the Outer Sect observation registry. This order.

text.content: As the words fell, the surroundings erupted in an uproar. Everyone present understood the weight of those four words—'observation registry'—it meant this person's talent had caught the Elders' attention, and he could be promoted to the Inner Sect at any moment. A servant who swept the grounds, about to soar to a higher branch?

choice.prompt: Facing the Inner Sect envoy's 'grace', how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Display an overwhelmed expression, bowing with all five limbs to thank the Elder for his generous favor, letting everyone see the typical reaction of a 'lucky waste.'
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as a sycophant
choices.risk_hint: Must suppress all emotions, perfect facial control is essential

dialogue.content: This disciple... this disciple is unworthy! How could I possibly receive the Elder's favor! Even if my body were ground to dust, it would be insufficient to repay this kindness!

choices.text: Respectful yet measured, neither servile nor arrogant
choices.description: Maintain basic disciple etiquette, neither excessively humble nor appearing arrogant, preserving the consistent low-profile persona.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the authentic image, avoid drawing attention
choices.risk_hint: Must precisely calibrate the balance—neither too fake nor too genuine

dialogue.content: This disciple kowtows to thank the Elder for his generous favor. I shall certainly cultivate diligently in the future, living up to the Sect's cultivation.

text.content: The steward tucked the order scroll into his sleeve but did not leave immediately. He stood with hands behind his back, his gaze slowly sweeping through the crowd before returning to Chen Ji. With an enigmatic smile, he spoke: 'Chen Ji, the Elder is quite curious about you. At the Inner Sect Lecture Assembly half a month from now, you must attend—at that time, the Elder will meet you personally.'

Meet him personally? Another stir ran through the crowd. To be summoned for a private audience with an Elder at the Lecture Assembly was practically a blessing from the heavens for an Outer Disciple. Many's gazes toward Chen Ji had shifted from envy to naked hostility—just凭什么? A waste,凭什么?

The steward's voice carried the condescension of one looking down from above. Chen Ji still kept his eyes lowered, his eyelashes casting small shadows beneath them. His fingers tightened slightly within his sleeve—the steward's every word and action was too deliberate, that scrutinizing gaze not like looking at a favored junior, but more like... examining goods.

Just then, a gust of mountain wind swept by, lifting the steward's wide sleeve. Chen Ji's gaze inadvertently passed over it, his pupils contracting sharply—a dark red rune was embroidered on the inside of that sleeve, shaped like a coiled serpent with tongue flicking, bearing a seventy percent resemblance to the pattern that had newly emerged on his Turtle Shell last night!

choice.prompt: Discovering the unusual rune on the steward's sleeve, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Maintain an unchanged expression while thanking the steward, bury this detail deep in your heart, and investigate it carefully after returning.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to probe on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Expose no clues, preserve hidden cards
choices.risk_hint: The steward may disappear from now on, uncertain when you'll meet again

text.content: Chen Ji bowed again, his expression still respectful and obedient: 'This disciple understands and will certainly live up to the Elder's expectations.' His voice was steady without a trace of波动, as if he had seen nothing at all. The steward gave him a deep look, nodded with profound meaning, then turned to board the sedan chair. The jade-green carriage rose into the air and vanished into the clouds and mist in an instant.

choices.description: Casually mention that rune pattern, observing how the steward reacts, probing how deep the water goes.
choices.visible_cost: May alert the snake, exposing your vigilance
choices.visible_reward: Perhaps extract more clues from the steward's reaction
choices.risk_hint: The steward is extremely scheming, likely to counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze clear yet dazed: 'This disciple ventures to ask, the pattern embroidered on the steward's sleeve earlier, it resembles an old object from this disciple's family. Might it be some kind of inheritance marker?' The steward's steps paused slightly, he turned his head back, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes before returning to normal: 'You're seeing things. Stop having random thoughts, focus on your cultivation.' With that, he brushed his sleeve and left, his pace notably faster than when he came.

As the sedan chair departed, the surrounding disciples gradually dispersed, though many deliberately bumped Chen Ji's shoulder as they passed, muttering jealous remarks. Chen Ji endured them all, never stopping, walking directly toward the Servants' Quarters. Sunlight filtered through gaps in the clouds, stretching his shadow long and solitary.

Returning to that cramped小屋, Chen Ji shut the door and leaned against the wall, slowly exhaling a breath of stale air. He took out the Turtle Shell from his chest, his thumb tracing over the rune that had emerged last night—coiled serpent with tongue flicking, identical to the mark on the steward's sleeve. Why would his father's legacy bear the same insignia as an Inner Sect steward? What is the steward's background with his 'Observe' character jade pendant?

Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record trembling slightly in the depths of his consciousness. He did not activate that ability to peer into the future—each use consumed five Heavenly Fate points, and unless absolutely necessary, he must never squander them. But Su Qingyao's riddle, the steward's rune, his father's legacy... these clues were like scattered chess pieces, faintly pointing toward the same chess game he had yet to see clearly.

He opened his eyes, his gaze falling on the half-withered old locust tree outside the window. The Inner Sect Lecture Assembly half a month away—he would apparently have to attend. Was this so-called 'Elder's attention' a blessing or a curse? A faint, extremely subtle arc curved at the corner of his lips—whatever it was, Chen Ji would accept it. Since the chess game has been set up, how could a chess player fear the pieces?

The setting sun slanted westward, dyeing the room in a dim golden hue. Chen Ji sat before the window, his fingers repeatedly tracing the runes on the Turtle Shell, his mind endlessly replaying the steward's gaze as he left—that was not the kindness of an Elder looking at a junior, but the scrutiny of a hunter discovering prey. He silently noted in his heart: this person is extremely scheming, his intentions far from simple as the surface word 'concern.'

What concerned him even more was that coiled serpent rune. The Tianji Record Fragment had never recorded such a marking, yet its resemblance to the patterns that had just appeared on the Turtle Shell was too similar to be coincidence. What did his father experience before his disappearance? What connection exists between the 'people of old' in the riddle and this rune? Question marks circled endlessly in Chen Ji's heart, like intertwining serpent tongues, ready to strike unexpectedly.

Just as he was lost in thought, the runes on the Turtle Shell suddenly glowed with a faint azure light, then fell silent. Chen Ji lowered his head to look—the characters seemed even clearer than before—as if something dormant was slowly awakening. He pressed the Turtle Shell close to his chest, feeling that faint yet persistent warmth, the arc at the corner of his lips deepening another degree.
